{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.67","title":"C/Zephyr: bounded consecutive SCHC decompression-failure tracker absent","description":"Requirement (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.7, Decompression Failure Handling): Production decompression ingress MUST maintain a bounded consecutive-failure tracker keyed by the authenticated link signer; unknown rules / truncated or non-canonical residues / invalid decompressed packets increment that signer; output-buffer or transport failure does not; success clears only that signer; threshold emits exactly one notification per consecutive run; when full, fail closed for untracked signers and MUST NOT evict existing runs.

Classification: not-implemented (C/Zephyr). Implemented+tested in Rust and Python.

Evidence:
- C absence: rg 'record_failure|FailureTracker|consecutive' lichen/subsys/ matches only TDMA desync counters (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c). Production C ingress is lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_rx.c -> lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c lichen_schc_decompress (schc.c:572) with no failure accounting.
- Rust: RuleVersionFailureTracker rust/lichen-schc/src/context.rs:43-108 (per-signer, saturating, one notification per run, fail-closed no-eviction); wired lichen_node::Stack.schc_failure_tracker (rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:224); test tracked_ingress_is_per_peer_and_capacity_fails_closed_without_eviction (rust/lichen-schc/tests/rule_versioning_vectors.rs:229).
- Python: RuleVersionFailureTracker python/src/lichen/schc/context.py:214-264, node wiring node.py:1318-1343 (_record_schc_failure), threshold default 3 / capacity 16 (node.py:221-222); vectors failure_tracker_capacity + failure_threshold (test/vectors/rule_versioning.json, consumer python/tests/test_vectors.py:919-951).
